name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, TLS, security headers, firewall rules, Fail2ban, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service management, runtime directories, logging, and compatibility configuration handling.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, a Git checkout, virtual environment, dependencies, environment configuration, and a systemd service running Uvicorn.
